summary: Today's briefing highlights a mixed legal and retail landscape, driven by high-profile corporate leadership changes at Flipkart and an insolvency lawsuit against Foxconn in India. Key judicial updates include upcoming Supreme Court rulings on the Sabarimala reference and murder convictions handed down by a Kerala court.

bullets.text: Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down from Flipkart after leading the e-commerce giant for more than 11 years.
Foxconn faces an insolvency lawsuit in India over unpaid vendor dues while continuing its competition against Tata Electronics.
PepsiCo India is investing over ₹800 crore to establish a new snack manufacturing plant in Tamil Nadu for Lay's and Kurkure.
The Supreme Court is expected to pronounce its verdict in the Sabarimala reference case by December this year.
A Kerala court sentenced three BJP-RSS workers to life imprisonment for the murder of CPI(M) worker CV Dhanaraj.
